page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.m2.medium is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance belonging to the ecs.m2 server family. It is built on the x86_64 CPU architecture and runs on the KVM hypervisor. The instance features 4 dedicated virtual CPUs (vCPUs) paired with 32.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core.

This server configuration does not include local NVMe or SSD storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through network-attached block storage. There are no integrated graphics processing units (GPUs) or complimentary public IPv4 addresses bundled with this instance type.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.m2.medium provides a high density of memory relative to its processing cores, making it a viable option for workloads requiring significant RAM without the overhead of additional vCPUs. This hardware profile is appropriate for memory-intensive applications, small to medium databases, caching layers, and enterprise applications that require dedicated CPU resources and a larger memory footprint.
